about_the_game:
So, where is the flock anyway? Lost on a mountain, that’s where! And it’s a dangerous one at that!

In Where The Flock!? – you’ll help an old Farmer rescue his lost herd of sheep from a treacherous mountain. Using a selection of tools – from parachutes to dynamite and more – you’ll guide the herd of tiny sheep back to safety.  

In this 10-level Demo, you'll get to experience the first biome of the full game - the might Mountain! You’ll devise unique strategies to solve each challenge in order to progress from one level to the next. Every level has more than one way to be solved, meaning success comes down to your own flavour of creativity with the tools at your disposal.

Inspired by classic A-to-B puzzle platformers of the 90’s, Where The Flock!? is a hand-crafted 2D pixel art adventure loaded to the brim with fun and nostalgia. See you on the mountain!

short_description: Save a herd of lost sheep from a treacherous mountain using a variety of helpful (but sometimes risky!) tools in this quirky 2D puzzle-platformer adventure. Devise unique strategies to solve dozens of levels across multiple chapters, and get the flock back to the farm, safe and sound.
